resources.string: Signed hook packs

Import only your own signed hook packs. Import does not execute code. Select a pack for an existing hook, publish its generation, and restart the target. The existing hook switches and safety locks still apply. Signed code is trusted, not sandboxed.

Select signed runtime for this hook
Stage this signed pack in place of its built-in implementation. Requires existing framework scope. Keep the existing per-hook opt-in switch; publish explicitly and restart the target.
Disable this migrated hook
Enter framework safe mode first, then stage this hook as disabled. Publish the remaining selection explicitly and restart targets. No automatic built-in fallback.
Stage retained previous version
Select only the already verified prior archive. The previous framework generation remains until an explicit publish. Restart the target after publishing.
Remove installed selection
Enter safe mode, remove this module selection and keep its old archives for audit. Its selected hooks remain disabled. Publish the remaining selection and restart targets.
Revoke publisher
Enter framework safe mode, permanently revoke this public key locally and disable its installed selections. Publish the remaining selection and restart targets.
Publish verified generation
Verify exact archive bytes and current scope, publish the selected generation, and verify framework readback. This exits safe mode. Restart target apps afterward.
Emergency safe mode
Block new dispatch of all five migration-eligible hooks, even if an archive is missing. Existing callbacks or UI may remain until targets restart. MCC stays independent.
